assertions.assertion: Explains that claims must be declared in the UserClaims collection of an IdentityResource, ApiScope, or ApiResource
assertions.rationale: States the claim type must be declared in a UserClaims collection of an IdentityResource, ApiScope, or ApiResource.

assertions.assertion: Shows adding 'department' to the UserClaims collection on the relevant ApiScope or ApiResource
assertions.rationale: Shows new ApiScope("api1", ...) { UserClaims = { "department" } } and ApiResource/IdentityResource alternatives.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that the client must also request the scope that contains the claim
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states the client must include the scope in AllowedScopes and request it.

assertions.assertion: Explains the relationship between AddRequestedClaims and RequestedClaimTypes — AddRequestedClaims filters to only requested claim types
assertions.rationale: Explains RequestedClaimTypes is built from resource UserClaims and that AddRequestedClaims only emits claims whose type is in RequestedClaimTypes.
